english.meaning: to provoke someone or make them angry
english.note: 激死 means infuriating. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Wow! It was sent there and sent right back. They said we couldn’t do it—so infuriating, honestly. Wow, fourteen grand!
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘩！真係嗰頭寄去嗰頭寄返來。話我哋唔得啝，真係激死𠻺真係，嘩！萬四蚊啊講真。
